sources.entry: Agent Monitor - Open-source desktop widgets and menu bar app that show which Claude Code and Codex sessions are waiting on you, open them on click, and track usage limits. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/paveler/agent-monitor) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app and WidgetKit desktop widgets that show Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly usage limits and which agent sessions are waiting for your input.
summary.what_it_does: Agent Monitor is a macOS app with two parts: a menu bar app that fetches usage data and watches agent sessions, and WidgetKit widgets in three sizes that display it. For usage, it shows the Claude and Codex rolling 5-hour and weekly windows as rings or bars, with countdowns to each reset, color warnings at 75% and 90%, and a freshness timestamp with a manual refresh. For sessions, it uses the agents' official lifecycle hooks (installed through an Integrations menu) to list sessions that need a tool approval, have a question, or have a plan to review, plus sessions whose turn has finished. Clicking a row opens the session in the Claude or Codex desktop app, or in the matching Terminal or iTerm2 tab; other hosts are just brought to front. The menu bar icon shows a count, red when something is blocked. The app reuses existing CLI logins and writes a JSON snapshot that the sandboxed widget reads.
use_cases: check how much Claude Code or Codex usage is left
see which AI coding agent is waiting for approval
get a desktop widget for AI agent rate limits
track multiple parallel Claude Code sessions
jump back to a stalled agent session
monitor Codex CLI usage from the menu bar
how_to_run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AgentMonitor.app (only if downloaded from Releases)
Launch Agent Monitor, then right-click desktop > Edit Widgets > add Agent Monitor
Click the menu bar icon > Integrations > Connect Claude Code and/or Connect Codex
git clone the repo, cd agent-monitor, ./scripts/install.sh (build from source, needs Xcode 15+)
notable: Waiting-on-you list driven by Claude Code and Codex official lifecycle hooks, with hooks installed and backed up automatically into the agents' settings files
Real WidgetKit widget in three sizes; the sandboxed widget reads a snapshot written by the menu bar app since widgets cannot read the Keychain
Click-to-jump opens exact sessions in Claude and Codex desktop apps via deep links, and the matching tab in Terminal and iTerm2
Zero configuration: reuses existing Claude Code Keychain token and Codex auth file; no analytics or telemetry
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later and Claude Code and/or Codex CLI signed in on the Mac
Usage endpoints for Claude and Codex are undocumented and may change without notice; Claude endpoint rate-limits and is polled every 5 minutes
App is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so downloaded copies need the quarantine flag cleared; Keychain access may be prompted again after updates
Widgets refresh only roughly every 15-30 minutes in the background; the menu bar is live
